title: State minimum git and OpenSSH versions
description: Neither DESIGN nor the code states a git or OpenSSH floor, yet the docs mention the OpenSSH 9.6 DST bug. Determine the real floors from what git-vouch uses: git gpg.format=ssh and gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile (git 2.34), ssh-keygen -Y sign/verify/find-principals and valid-after/valid-before in allowed_signers (OpenSSH 8.x), sk- key support, namespaces= option, -Y match-principals if used, RSA rsa-sha2-512 signing. Verify each against upstream release notes (cite them) and, where possible, test against an older binary. Add the floors to DESIGN and the cover note; consider a runtime version check in git vouch setup only if one is cheap.
acceptance_criteria: DESIGN and cover note state git and OpenSSH minimums with cited release notes; claims checked; tests pass.
close_reason: Floors git 2.35, OpenSSH 9.1 measured and cited in DESIGN Constraints item 2, Upstream path, decisions summary, and for-kernel-reviewers
